name: SA Cost of Living Concession
summary: Yearly cash payment for South Australian renters and homeowners on Youth Allowance, Austudy, ABSTUDY or with a Low Income Health Care Card.
who: Hold an eligible card (such as a Low Income Health Care Card), receive an eligible payment such as Youth Allowance, Austudy or ABSTUDY, or meet the low income provisions
Tenants must hold a written rental agreement
how: Apply with the online household concessions form, a paper form, or by calling ConcessionsSA on 1800 307 758.
If you received it before and nothing has changed, you don't need to reapply.
catches: You must apply by 31 December to get the COLC for that financial year.
Payments are made between August and December by EFT.
